jobs.title: AP Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement Specialist
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is looking for a AP Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement Specialist.

You will own the data and reporting layer of our AP function - building and maintaining the dashboards and KPI frameworks that give the team and leadership a real-time view of performance. Beyond reporting, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives end-to-end: identifying inefficiencies, designing solutions, coordinating input from the team and driving implementation.

You sit at the intersection of AP operations, data and process design. You will partner closely with the Global AP SME to ensure improvement initiatives align with global standards, and with the broader team to translate operational experience into measurable change.

You’re welcome to work in our offices in Amsterdam.

Your responsibilities will include:

Reporting and analytics

- Own AP reporting and dashboard management - maintain accuracy, relevance and accessibility of operational data

- Produce and interpret KPI reporting: on-time payment, ZIP aging, hold rates, escalation coverage and root cause analysis

- Identify trends, anomalies and patterns in AP data and translate them into actionable insights for the team and leadership

- Build and maintain automated reporting workflows - reduce manual data handling wherever possible

- Prepare ad hoc analysis for Finance leadership as needed

Continuous improvement

- Lead continuous improvement initiatives end-to-end - coordinate input from the team including Senior AP Accountants, design solutions, drive implementation and track outcomes

- Work with the Global AP SME to ensure improvement initiatives align with global process standards before implementation

- Support automation efforts and reduction of manual work within AP workflows

- Document process changes and ensure improvements are embedded and sustained

- Monitor the impact of changes through data - close the loop between initiative and outcome

We expect you to have:

- 4-6 years of experience in Finance Operations, AP analytics, FP&A, or a comparable analytical role within Finance

- Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience building dashboards and KPI frameworks - Excel (advanced), BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)

- Experience leading or coordinating process improvement projects from identification through to implementation

- Solid understanding of AP processes - you do not need to have been an AP accountant, but you need to understand how AP works

- Comfortable working with and extracting data from ERP systems - NetSuite experience is a strong advantage

- Structured, project-oriented approach to your work

- Strong communication skills - able to translate data into stories that non-analytical stakeholders can act on

- Excellent written and verbal English - English is our primary working language and the expected standard of communication throughout the team

- Working knowledge of spoken and written English

It will be an added bonus if you have:

- Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma or another continuous improvement methodology

- Experience with Zip, Blackline or similar AP-specific tools

- Exposure to automation tools or scripting (Python, SQL) for data workflows

- Experience in a high-growth or technology company

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

Data Center Operations Manager – Facilities

Location: Lappeenranta, Finland Department: Data Center Operations / Critical Facilities Reports To: Regional Operations Director or Site Director

The Data Center Operations Manager – Facilities is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all critical facility infrastructure within the data center campus in Lappeenranta, Finland. This role oversees day-to-day operations of mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), cooling, power distribution, and building management systems while ensuring maximum uptime, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in mission-critical facilities with leadership capability, vendor management experience, and a proactive operational mindset. The role requires maintaining high availability standards while supporting growth, sustainability initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.

- Manage daily operations and maintenance of critical infrastructure systems including:

- Generators

- Switchgear and transformers

- HVAC and cooling systems

- Chillers and CRAH/CRAC units

- Fire detection and suppression systems

- Building Management Systems (BMS)

- Electrical distribution systems

- Ensure continuous uptime and reliability of all mission-critical systems.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives for reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.

- Monitor KPIs including uptime, energy efficiency, incident response, and maintenance completion.

- Support capacity planning and infrastructure expansion projects.

Vendor & Contractor Management

- Manage relationships with external service providers and contractors.

- Ensure vendors comply with site safety requirements, SLAs, and operational standards.

- Coordinate maintenance windows and project execution activities.

Compliance & Safety

- Ensure compliance with Finnish regulations, environmental standards, and industry best practices.

- Support ISO, environmental, and operational audits.

- Maintain compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) programs.

- Participate in risk assessments and emergency preparedness activities.

Sustainability & Energy Management

- Support energy efficiency initiatives and sustainability targets.

- Monitor PUE and optimize cooling and electrical efficiency.

- Contribute to renewable energy integration and environmental performance programs where applicable.

- Strong problem-solving and incident management skills.

Role Overview

The FP&A Analyst – Business Cases & Investments plays a critical role within the Group Finance team, evaluating strategic and operational investment decisions across the business. The role demands a highly analytical individual capable of operating with autonomy, synthesising complex financial and non-financial data, and delivering clear, evidence-based recommendations to senior leadership.

This is a high-visibility role that partners directly with business unit leaders, the Executive team, and cross-functional stakeholders to appraise capital allocation decisions, model scenarios, track cashflow implications, and monitor delivery against approved cases. The ideal candidate combines rigorous financial modelling skills with commercial acumen and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.

Key Responsibilities

Business Case & Investment Modelling

- Develop, own, and continuously refine financial models for business cases, investment proposals, and strategic initiatives across the Group.

- Build scenario, sensitivity, and Monte Carlo analyses to quantify risk and opportunity, providing decision-makers with a range of credible outcomes.

- Translate complex financial and operational assumptions into coherent, auditable model structures that can be understood and challenged by non-technical stakeholders.

- Evaluate capital expenditure proposals, including ROI, IRR, NPV, and payback analysis across short- and long-term horizons.

- Work with limited direction and exercise sound judgment to determine the right analytical approach for each investment question.

Cashflow Modelling & Forecasting

- Build and maintain detailed cashflow models that integrate operating, investing, and financing activities — both at the project level and as part of Group-wide forecasts.

- Develop long-term (multi-year) cashflow forecasts, incorporating business case assumptions, capex schedules, and working capital dynamics.

- Model cashflow sensitivity to key assumptions (revenue ramp, capex timing, financing draws) to support liquidity planning and covenant monitoring.

- Analyse forecast vs. actual cashflow variances, identifying root causes and providing actionable insight to improve future forecast accuracy.

- Quantify the cashflow impact of proposed investments and business cases, including funding requirements, drawdown profiles, and payback timelines.

- Support treasury and corporate finance teams with cashflow projections used in debt facility negotiations, ABL covenant reporting, and investor communications.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

- Integrate multiple financial and non-financial data sources (operational KPIs, market data, customer metrics, engineering outputs) to form a holistic view of investment performance and potential.

- Identify data gaps and work proactively with Finance, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence teams to improve the quality and availability of inputs.

- Monitor approved investments post-close, tracking actual performance against business case assumptions and providing clear variance commentary.

- Develop insight-led reporting that goes beyond the numbers — surfacing the 'so what' for leadership audiences.

Strategic & Financial Planning Support

- Support the FP&A team in long-range planning cycles, integrating investment pipeline analysis with Group P&L and cashflow forecasts.

- Prepare P&L, balance sheet, and cashflow impacts of proposed investments, including funding structure implications.

- Contribute to Group-wide scenario planning and stress-testing exercises that inform the annual budget and strategic plan.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

- 6+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis, or management consulting.

- Proven track record building complex, multi-driver financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Demonstrated experience constructing cashflow models and forecasts, including direct and indirect cashflow methods, working capital movements, and capex scheduling.

- Data fluency: High comfort with large, complex, and imperfect data sets.

APAC represents a developing and rapidly expanding operational theatre for Nebius. They will serve as the NGSCS authority for all things APAC, working in close alignment with global leadership while operating with the independence required to get things done in a complex and fast-moving regional environment.

- Build the NGSCS APAC security function from the ground up, establishing the operational framework, regional risk profile, and partner ecosystem required to secure Nebius supply chain operations across the region

- Define and implement regional adaptations of global NGSCS security standards, ensuring they are operationally effective across diverse APAC markets and jurisdictions

- Identify, assess, and onboard regional security vendors, guarding providers, logistics partners, and technology platforms in alignment with NGSCS requirements

- Map and assess the APAC supply chain security landscape, identifying key threat vectors, market-specific risks, and operational vulnerabilities across the region

- Establish NGSCS's presence and authority across the APAC vendor and logistics partner network, setting clear expectations for security performance from the outset

- Own and lead warehouse security across all APAC facilities, with full accountability for facility-level risk and performance

- Ensure the secure storage, handling, and integrity of high-value assets across all warehouse and staging facilities in the region

- Establish and enforce security requirements across logistics partners operating warehouse and storage facilities, including 3PLs and co-located vendors across APAC markets

- Conduct and oversee facility security assessments and audits, benchmarking against TAPA FSR and NGSCS standards

- Lead end-to-end response to warehouse security incidents (e.g., theft, loss, unauthorized access, inventory discrepancies), including coordination, investigation, and resolution

Transportation Security

- Own and lead transportation security across all APAC shipment lanes, with full accountability for in-transit risk and performance

- Ensure the secure handling, packaging, and movement of high-value assets across all transportation nodes within the APAC region

- Establish and enforce security requirements across transportation partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, and last-mile delivery providers across APAC markets

- Conduct risk assessments across transportation routes, handoff points, and carrier operations, and implement effective mitigation strategies

- Manage GPS tracking, geofencing, and real-time monitoring of assets across active regional shipments

- Serve as the sole NGSCS authority and escalation point for all supply chain security matters across APAC
